Library: backtesting_engine

Purpose: Historical simulation of strategies, reporting and performance analysis.

Key Modules:
- backtesting_engine.py: `BacktestingEngine.run_backtest(...)`, `run_parameter_optimization(...)`, `run_monte_carlo_simulation(...)`, `run_walk_forward_analysis(...)`.
- strategy_simulator.py: Strategy execution logic per bar.
- performance_analyzer.py: KPIs (win rate, drawdown, Sharpe, PnL, etc.).
- report_generator.py: Aggregated results and export.

CLI (cli.py):
- Entrypoint: `python -m backtesting.src.lib.backtesting_engine.cli`
- Flags: `--help`, `--version`, `--format json|text`
- Commands: `run`, `optimize`, `walk-forward`, `report`

Data Contracts:
- BacktestResult (backtesting/src/models/backtest_result.py)
- BacktestTrade (backtesting/src/models/backtest_trade.py)

Notes:
- Deterministic where feasible; ensure reproducibility for analysis.
